profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Full-stack Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry. Skilled in front-end web frameworks, back-end web development, dev-ops and infrastructure. Goal is to become a well-rounded CTO with the technical know-how and people skills to help peers succeed. General Assembly alumni.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Take a hands-on approach, overseeing the end-to-end development process from design to deployment. Ensure on-time delivery of initiatives by actively participating in coding, conducting thorough code reviews, and upholding coding
standards and best practices.
- Collaborate closely with cross functional teams, including product managers, eCommerce, design, and engineering, fostering seamless integration of Shopify features that align with project goals and stakeholder expectations.
- Incorporate website performance optimization as an integral part of the development process, ensuring a frictionless user experience. Successfully implemented initiatives that reduced homepage load time from 14 seconds to an impressive 6 seconds within the first year.
- Prioritize ADA compliance throughout the development process, enabling inclusivity and access for customers who utilize screen readers.
- Take the lead in bi-yearly cross team collaboration sessions focused on image optimization. Facilitate discussions and implement effective image optimization strategies, resulting in improved website performance, reduced page load times, and an enhanced user experience.
- Led and executed three full-scale website migrations from Salesforce to Shopify, utilizing hands-on expertise in React and Vue.js. Ensure a seamless transition, minimal downtime, and enhanced platform performance, streamlining ecommerce operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Cross-Functional Team Building · Technical Product Management

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Lead a small shopify engineering team during our 6-month project, providing project management by creating tickets in Jira and organizing weekly sprints. This process allowed us to finish our portion of the project with two week sprints left to spare
Prepared base infrastructure and process for Shopify development and deployment, providing documentation available on Confluence for Staging and Production sites 
Delivered a unified website experience two sprints ahead of schedule, with partnership and teamwork of our shopify engineers, streaming product team, joining Shopify and React for a semi-headless eCommerce experience
Reduced page load times from 10 seconds to 5.1 seconds, leading to 3% increase in conversion rate
Collaborate with Analytics, CX, Product, and Marketing to ensure that our team projects are delivered on time

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Built front-end websites in Shopify according to design for clients
Developed a toolkit to streamline development process in Shopify. Leading to a 30% increase in site performance
Prepared a CI/CD pipeline for complex application projects on Google Cloud and AWS
Assisted in the hiring process of developers by organizing interviews and preparing tests
Led and organized developer meetings and weekly training exercises

positions.title: Co-Founder/Advisor/Web Developer/Infrastructure
positions.description:
Co-Founded petcreds with a focus on the technical side of the business
Prepared a CI/CD pipeline for full-stack applications with deployment to Google Cloud
Developed backend code in Ruby-on-Rails
Cooperated in building front-end pages based on designs

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer/iOS Developer
positions.description:
Freelance Developer of websites ofsmortgage.com, nydo.co, hookah2go.nyc, cronostimepieces.com 
Nanodegree for iOS development from Udacity.com

educations.schoolName: Queensborough Community College of The City University of New York (CUNY)
